scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
probes: unread words and register contents at the reached OUT (knockout-identified) on the ask tick

witnesses.templates: XOR out,out,j | IN^k t; XOR out,out,t | LDC t,15; MUL t,t,j; XOR out,out,t (+IN^k) | PUT-neutral 10/12-instruction template
witnesses.reading: minimal verified size = UPPER BOUND on distance

intermediates: prefix fitness in insertion order; drop-one necessity

census.structured: insert + replace (op in ['XOR', 'ADD', 'SUB', 'OR', 'AND', 'MUL', 'MOV', 'IN'], a=out, b=out, c=j) at every position, 2 held set screen with the baseline on the same sets, beneficial / hits confirmed on 4
census.grammar: 2000 one-op and 2000 two-op mutants (v0.4), 2 held sets, beneficial / hits confirmed on 4 (cap 300)
